summary: This sermon addresses how a church can move from merely obeying the command to love one another to developing genuine affection and familial bonds. The catalyst for this transformation is the practice of honor—choosing to assign high value to one another in the same way God valued us by sending Christ.
key_points: Paul's mission for the church: love each other, hate sin, hold to what is good
Paul's vision: move from commanded love (agape) to genuine affection (phileo)
The key behavior: honor one another by assigning high value to each person
God demonstrated our value by paying the ultimate price—Christ's blood
Compete to outdo one another in showing honor, not in seeking honor for yourself
big_idea: A church cultivates genuine affection when its members choose to honor one another by assigning the same high value to each person that God demonstrated by sacrificing Christ for them.
title: An Honoring Church
